claims: Czechia is a landlocked Central European nation.
Czechia has a population of over 10 million.
Prague is the capital of Czechia.
Prague is the largest city of Czechia.
Czechia is a parliamentary democracy.
Czechia is a member of the EU.
Czechia is a member of NATO.
Czechia shares borders with Germany, Poland, Slovakia, and Austria.
The official language of Czechia is Czech.
The currency of Czechia is Czech Koruna (CZK).
The major cities of Czechia are Prague, Brno, Ostrava, Plzeň (Pilsen).
The regions of Czechia are Bohemia, Moravia, and Silesia.
Czechia was formed as an independent state on January 1, 1993.
Czechia was formed following the peaceful dissolution of Czechoslovakia.
Czechia has 2,000+ castles.
Pilsner originated in Czechia.
Czechia is part of the Schengen Area.
Czechia is a parliamentary republic.
The President is the head of state of Czechia.
The Prime Minister is the head of government of Czechia.
